content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-fonts-online-without-paypal-what-nobody-tells-11|Selling Fonts]] a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually-5|COREMERCH guide to creators]], the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-guide-6|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-12. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This architecture is designed for digital creators who face restrictions from conventional payment platforms. The ability to sell music while accepting Bitcoin provides a route to financial independence and ownership over one’s work. With conventional platforms charging steep fees—like Gumroad's 10%—the sovereignty of using tools like NOWPayments, which only charges 0.5%, becomes a game changer. This model not only empowers creators but also ensures they retain more revenue from their sales, allowing for sustainable growth.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture combines free and paid tools that work seamlessly together. The hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring fast delivery and reliability. The backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating processes like order fulfillment and payment verification. NOWPayments serves as the payment processor, confirming transactions in real-time and accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies. This stack allows creators to focus on their content while the infrastructure operates efficiently behind the scenes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This setup is tailored for digital creators, specifically those in regions where traditional payment gateways are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you are a musician selling beats, an educator offering online courses, or a designer selling templates, this architecture empowers you to take control of your sales and payments. It's designed for those who value ownership and wish to avoid the pitfalls of dependency on third-party platforms.
Own your infrastructure, never rent it.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of several key components: a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, a backend processing method using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment solution via NOWPayments. These components are integrated to ensure that creators can not only sell their digital products effectively but also deliver them automatically to customers. This setup minimizes the need for manual intervention, allowing for a streamlined operation that saves time and enhances user experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, select a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and set up your account. Next, configure your backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. After that, integrate NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin. Finally, upload your digital products and test the entire process to ensure seamless delivery and payment verification. For those looking for a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to facilitate your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Maximize your revenue by minimizing fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using platforms that accept cryptocurrency payments, like NOWPayments. This method bypasses traditional payment processors and allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.

Using NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin with only a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than many platforms. This approach maximizes your profits and reduces reliance on third-party platforms.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own digital store using the architecture outlined here. Utilizing tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments allows you to operate independently.
What are the key advantages of this infrastructure?
The key advantages include full ownership of your store, low fees with NOWPayments, and the ability to automate delivery. This setup minimizes costs and enhances control over your sales.
How quickly can I deploy this solution?
You can have your digital store up and running in as little as 48 hours using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, ensuring a rapid deployment of your online business.
